subject.title: Workboard: duplicate proof entries on completion; 'passed' is worker self-assessment, not verification

question: Should Workboard retain `passed` for worker self-attestation with explicit documentation, introduce a distinct attested status, or define an optional verifier contract that can promote proof to verified?
rationale: The duplicate-write path is potentially a bounded bug, but the requested status semantics and verifier extension define a consumer-visible Workboard contract that cannot be selected safely from the report alone.

options.title: Separate attested and verified states
options.body: Use a worker-attested state distinct from independently verified proof, with promotion performed only by an explicit verifier contract.

options.title: Keep `passed` as attested proof
options.body: Retain the current status name but document that it records the worker’s self-assessment and does not guarantee external validation.

options.title: Limit this item to deduplication
options.body: Fix only a confirmed duplicate-write defect and defer all proof-semantics changes to a separate product discussion.

recommendation.title: Separate attested and verified states
recommendation.body: Use a worker-attested state distinct from independently verified proof, with promotion performed only by an explicit verifier contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The report frames the contract decision and contains the production context needed to evaluate downstream expectations.
